title: Writing Someday Sweetheart and Wolverine Blues
summary: Someday Sweetheart was written in 1920, popular by 1923-24 through Melrose Brothers; Wolverine Blues became a hit and launched Jelly Roll Morton in the East.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: What year did you write "Someday Sweetheart"?

We wrote that in '20 before we even opened the music store, while we were still working up in 'Frisco, but it didn't get popular till around '23 or '4 and after we sent it around the East, and this guy would sing it and this guy would play it. Then, after a couple of failures with different music publishers, Melrose Brothers got it, and they made it famous, you know, and then, from then on, we wrote "Wolverine Blues," which was a big hit now with Jelly Roll Morton and "Froggie Moore" and Jelly Roll, and that started Jelly Roll.
